description: [$0.001/call, wallet required] End-of-day US equity quote: last close, day range, previous close and the change between them. US equities only; indices, FX and crypto are not covered (crypto-price serves those). Built from a four-venue consolidation (Databento DBEQ.BASIC), so the prices track the wider market but the volume counts those four venues only and is returned as venueVolume rather than as a total. No 52-week range and no intraday print: for a date range call stock-history.

Idempotency-Key.description: Same key + same credential + same body replays the paid result without charging again.

symbol.description: US equity ticker, e.g. AAPL. Indices, FX and crypto are not covered.
